name: axe-accessibility
description: Deque's accessibility toolkit for coding agents. Get accessible UI effortlessly - your agent builds, tests, and remediates accessibility in the loop, so it's never a separate, manual chore. Currently powers the Axe MCP Server scan -> remediate -> verify workflow, plus on-request guided tests for keyboard access, interactive elements, and modal dialogs; expanding over time.

api_key.title: Axe API key
api_key.description: Axe MCP Server API key from the Axe Account Portal (API Keys -> product "Axe MCP Server"). Leave blank if you sign in with OAuth (npx -y @deque/axe-auth@1.6.0 login).
